description: At session start in a zaf project (a .zaf.toml, a .zaf/config.toml or the retired ZAF.toml), run `zaf doctor` and print its table; elsewhere, do nothing.

hooks.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.zaf.toml" ] || [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.zaf/config.toml" ] || [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/ZAF.toml" ] || exit 0; if command -v zaf >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'zaf doctor:'; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && zaf doctor 2>&1; else echo 'zaf doctor: this project has a zaf manifest but zaf is not on PATH'; fi; exit 0
